provenance: Entirely original synthetic teaching data. Future calendar labels are fictional, not observations or forecasts. No external datasets or live prices.

conventions.returns: simple total returns, decimal per period

monthly.mandate: Frozen at date 0, 1 January 2027: compare same-currency total-return wealth with the supplied monthly policy index. This index is stipulated frictionlessly investable at zero fee only in this case. Report gross and net outcomes, leverage/style exposures and every external cash flow. A fitted factor model supplements, never silently replaces, this benchmark.
monthly.factor_scope: M is the excess return of the stipulated investable policy index over cash; Z is a synthetic zero-cost long-short style payoff per fixed CU notional. The observed sequences are constructed for an attribution exercise, not random samples proving a premium. Funding/short costs for any actual replication would need separate specification.

attribution.scope: A separate fully invested long-only two-month sleeve, not a sector reconstruction of the eight-month fund. Holdings are fixed within each month, then costlessly rebalanced to the supplied next-month weights. No external flows, fees, taxes or other assets.

panel.scope: Separate four-year synthetic fund universe. All entries are announced and investable at that year opening. Exits occur after that year total net liquidation return. Returns include fund fees and liquidation proceeds; no extra investor dealing cost. Fixed-cohort strategies retain closure proceeds as zero-return cash; an all-available strategy instead rebalances equally at each next opening. No backfilled or imputed pre-entry returns. Initial cohort is fixed at date 0; ranking occurs after Y2, and Y3-Y4 is the untouched outcome window.
